deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] attempt prom-2026-03-21-17 -> FAILED at step 'artifact-verification' (artifact=cc-native-lib/1.2.3.so)

mike: Seeing the failure in staging smoke: signature/sha mismatch. did the uploader flip?

sofia: yep, docker crashes on startup because the native lib is truncated. quick stack: ld.so: 'cc-native-lib.so' unexpected EOF

priya: Can you paste the verify log?

mike: ```
VERIFY: artifact cc-native-lib/1.2.3.so
computed_sha256=abc1234f...
signed_sha256=def5678a...
result: MISMATCH
S3 GET: 200, content-length=0 (range request returned empty)
```

sam: we had an S3 partial write incident in eu-west around 2026-03-21T16:48 UTC. was the uploader region eu-west?

luis: @mike which uploader job wrote that object? if it retried a failed multipart, we might have an empty part registered.

mike: uploader job id=98432 (gradle-cache-uploader, runner=staging-08). logs show SIGPIPE then clean exit and retry created the object with zero bytes.

priya: OK. Suggested immediate mitigations:
- HOLD the promotion (stop auto-promo)
- pin the release in the console to last-good tag v2026.03.19 so nothing accidental goes to prod
- manual reupload of the artifact from the build-worker's /artifacts cache or from the canonical build bucket
- verify checksums then resume promo

sofia: +1 for pin. promo didn't finish so prod unchanged, but we should avoid a second auto-attempt. also we need a release-note blurb: "skipped promo due to artifact verification failure; manual reupload and checksum validation performed"

deploy-bot: [ACTION] prom-2026-03-21-17 set to status=HOLD by automation. Auto-retry disabled for this promo.

mike: starting manual reupload from build-worker-12. copying file now, will run sha256 on origin and uploaded object.

ops-bot: FYI @eng-oncall there was an S3 PUT anomaly earlier (incident INC-2026-0319-1). Link: https://status.example.com/incidents/INC-2026-0319-1

luis: once reupload completes, please paste new computed_sha256 and the verification output. we'll want a postmortem note on the uploader so it checks content-length before marking uploaded.

mike: reupload done. computed_sha256 on origin= 9f7e2c1b...
gradle-uploader verified upload -> s3 object content-length=153624, sha256=9f7e2c1b...
rerunning promote verification...

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] re-run verification for prom-2026-03-21-17 -> OK. artifact checksums match. Promotion can proceed when a human approves.

priya: I'll approve and trigger. Also adding a temporary guard in CI: fail build if artifact content-length < expected and send alert to #eng-releases.

sofia: update release notes with the blurb and call out mitigation for the uploader (added preflight check + retry backoff).

mike: ack. filing a small PR to uploader: add content-length validation + retry sanity and a health check.

luis: can we schedule the follow-up for the next change window tomorrow 09:00 PT? want ops to validate cross-region PUTs.

priya: yes. I'll add it to the changelog and calendar event.

sam: thanks all — good catch. :thumbsup:

mike: Promo resumed and completed at 2026-03-21T17:06:00Z. marking thread resolved.

sofia: thanks, closing the hold. I'll update the release notes and put the uploader fix in the sprint.

deploy-bot: [INFO] prom-2026-03-21-17 status=COMPLETED (manual approval).
